mapping.summary: Two-way sync of items, variants, attributes and images between BC and Plytix PIM.
claims: Creates or updates BC items as Plytix products with SKU, GTIN, label and family
Publishes variant groups as parent products with linked variants
Maps item attributes to six Plytix attribute types, targeting parent, variant or both
Adds new dropdown values in Plytix automatically during export
Stores Plytix product and parent IDs on the BC item
Imports products changed in Plytix on a schedule, batching large catalogues
Imports only products changed since the last run
Imports locale-specific attribute values and supports calculated attributes
Brings product images into BC and sets the Plytix thumbnail as main image
Checks for existing products by SKU before export to avoid duplicates
Includes a portal to monitor flows, get alerts and resubmit failed transactions
